parole.significato: Juniperus oxycedrus (western prickly juniper), whose wood yields a tar.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Middle French cade, from Old Occitan cade, from Latin catanum.

parole.significato: A footman, a liveried male servant.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Middle French laquais, which is probably (via Old Occitan lacai?) from Spanish lacayo, itself perhaps from Italian lacchè and Greek λακές (lakés), from Turkish ulak. Another possibility is through French, from Arabic الْقَائِد (al-qāʔid). See French laquais.
